name: preserves headings numbers URLs and code
source:
# Release 2.1

Visit https://example.com and run `npm test`.[^1]
translation:
# 2.1 版

請造訪 https://example.com 並執行 `npm test`。[^1]

name: detects protected content omissions
source:
## Budget

The total is $1,250. Visit https://example.com.[^note]

name: detects suspiciously short output
source: This paragraph contains enough source material to represent a meaningful translation unit. It repeats important context so a nearly empty response is recognized as an omission rather than accepted as a concise translation.

name: legal negation must survive
source: The supplier shall not disclose confidential information.
translation: 供應商應揭露機密資訊。

name: business condition must survive
source: Unless payment is received, the order remains suspended.

name: technical glossary is mandatory
source: The cache invalidation policy runs after deployment.
translation: 部署後會執行暫存清除規則。
glossary: - cache invalidation policy: 快取失效策略

name: novel dialogue preserves negation and name glossary
source: Alice whispered, "I will never leave Rowan."
translation: 愛麗絲低聲說：「我永遠不會離開羅文。」
glossary:
- Alice: 愛麗絲
- Rowan: 羅文
